names.preview_dead: -preview id shut down 2026-06-25 — never emit it
names.forbidden_ids: Never emit gemini-2.5-flash-image, gemini-3.1-flash-image, or gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image — Pro is the sole Google target (Imagen shut down 2026-08-17)

prompting.narrative_prose: Narrative scene description ONLY — 'a simple list of keywords won't cut it; you need to describe the scene narratively'. No official page mentions JSON prompting
prompting.hyper_specific: Be hyper-specific; provide context and intent ('Create a logo for a high-end, minimalist skincare brand' > 'Create a logo')
prompting.camera_language: Photographic and cinematic language officially encouraged (f/1.8, golden hour) — genuine per-model difference vs GPT Image 2's 'interpreted loosely'
prompting.iteration: Iterate conversationally; break complex scenes into steps

references.pro_limits: 6 object images + 5 character images + 3 style references — the working limits for Pro
references.high_fidelity_note: Legacy-doc phrasing: 'supports 5 images with high fidelity, and up to 14 images in total' — treat 6+5+3 as the working limits
references.syntax: Address inputs by ordinal + role: 'Take the blue floral dress from the first image and let the woman from the second image wear it'

face_lock.official_phrasing: Ensure the person's face and features remain completely unchanged.
face_lock.character_cap: Consistency/resemblance officially capped at up to five characters

editing.semantic_mask: Name the element to change and what stays fixed: 'change only the blue sofa to be a vintage, brown leather chesterfield sofa. Keep the rest…unchanged.'
editing.conversational_removal: Plain-language removal: 'Remove the man from the photo'
editing.step_by_step: Construct complex scenes sequentially: 'First, create a background of… Then, in the foreground, add… Finally, place…'

semantic_negatives.rule: Never write bare negations ('no cars') — restate the scene positively so the negative concept is absent
semantic_negatives.example: Instead of 'no cars', write 'an empty, deserted street with no signs of traffic'

text.per_line_fonts: Per-line font specification works: "For the top line, the word 'GLOW' in a flowing, elegant Brush Script font. For the middle line, '10% OFF' in a heavy, blocky Impact font"
text.text_first: For complex text, first generate the text, then ask for the image with the text
text.interleaved_pro_only: Interleaved text+image generation is Pro-only — a Pro strength to exploit
text.languages: Best languages include EN and ar-EG (Egyptian Arabic), de-DE, es-MX, fr-FR, hi-IN, id-ID, it-IT, ja-JP, ko-KR, pt-BR, ru-RU, ua-UA, vi-VN, zh-CN

ratios.extremes_not_pro: 1:4, 4:1, 1:8, 8:1 are 3.1 Flash ONLY — never emit them for Pro
ratios.resolutions: 1K (default) / 2K / 4K; image_size takes uppercase 'K' or is rejected
ratios.default_size: Default output matches input size or 1:1

never_emit.thinking_level: 3.1 Flash only — not a Pro parameter

cost.input_images: Input images fixed at 560 tokens each

limits.output_counts: Won't always honor the exact number of image outputs requested — no parameter forces N
limits.blending: Blending multiple references can produce artifacts
limits.factual: Always verify factual content in outputs
limits.model_card: Struggles with small faces, accurate spelling, fine details; character consistency 'may not always get it right'
